concerns.text: FR-001 requires at least three public tabular datasets, but the plan’s ‘Verified Datasets’ table lists only two (UCI HAR and UCI Shopper). The shortfall is noted, yet no amendment to the spec is made, leaving the functional requirement unmet.

The plan concretely defines the control‑perturbation datasets (full column‑wise permutation for correlation and a fixed 5 % marginal perturbation) without any corresponding amendment in the spec (FR‑021 contains a '[deferred]' placeholder). Introducing these concrete values without updating the spec creates a mismatch between plan and specification.
